SCOUT WITHDRAWS THE SLICE 3 EVIDENCE BLOCK after an independent actual-type mutation court on exact landed merge cb16e8a. No shared-tree edit; disposable ordinary clone, pinned grakern 0329c43.

Mutation: change AlignmentRow, AlignmentMatrix, HsmmConfig, CostWeights, and StructuralProgram from final class to final case class, with no other source or test change. Clean compilation succeeded for production and test sources. AlignBoundarySuite: 6 total, 4 failed, 2 passed. The four named failures were exactly the Mirror.ProductOf boundary assertions for AlignmentRow line 32, AlignmentMatrix line 43, HsmmConfig line 62, and CostWeights line 77. The positive case-class control and public-read/factory sibling passed. StructuralProgramBoundarySuite: 3 total, 1 failed, 2 passed; exact Mirror.ProductOf boundary assertion failed at line 31, while the positive case-class control and smart-constructor/read sibling passed. Both commands exited nonzero only because the intended tests failed.

Restored all five classes to final non-case form via patch; git status and git diff --exit-code are clean. Chief merged-tree GATE_EXIT=0 remains the restored-code proof. This mutation signature proves the landed probes are capable of detecting reintroduction for all five types, so no follow-up source change is required. Original non-blocking notes remain separate possible beads: Coverage addition has a hidden throwing overflow path, and HsmmConfig.of accepts positive-infinite refinementWeight.
